text_en: The word of the Lord came to Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
text_cn: 那时，有上主的话传于哈纳尼的儿子耶胡，斥责巴厄沙说：

text_en: “Since I exalted you out of the dust and made you leader over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have caused my people Israel to sin, provoking me to anger with their sins,
text_cn: “我由尘埃中提拔了你，立你做我民以色列的领袖，你却走了雅洛贝罕的路，使我民以色列犯罪，激怒我；

text_en: therefore, I will consume Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat.
text_cn: 现在，我要扫除巴厄沙和他的家族，使他的家如同乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕的一家一样；

text_en: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city the dogs shall eat; and anyone of his who dies in the field the birds of the air shall eat. ”
text_cn: 凡属巴厄沙家的人，死在城中的，必为狗吞食，死在田野间的，必为空中的飞鸟啄食。”

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, what he did, and his power, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?
text_cn: 巴厄沙其余的事迹，他所行的事和他的功绩，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: Baasha slept with his ancestors, and was buried at Tirzah; and his son Elah succeeded him.
text_cn: 巴厄沙与列祖同眠，葬在提尔匝；他的儿子厄拉继位为王。

text_en: Moreover the word of the Lord came by the prophet Jehu son of Hanani against Baasha and his house, both because of all the evil that he did in the sight of the Lord , provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and also because he destroyed it.
text_cn: 上主藉哈纳尼的儿子，先知耶胡传话斥责巴厄沙和他的家族，是因为他行了许多上主眼中视为恶的事，以自己的作为激怒了上主，如同雅洛贝罕的家一样；又因为他杀了雅洛贝罕全家。

text_en: In the twenty-sixth year of King Asa of Judah, Elah son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah; he reigned two years.
text_cn: 犹大王阿撒二十六年，巴厄沙的儿子厄拉在提尔匝登极作以色列王，在位凡二年。

text_en: But his servant Zimri, commander of half his chariots, conspired against him. When he was at Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was in charge of the palace at Tirzah,
text_cn: 他的臣仆，即率领他半数战车的队长，齐默黎结党背叛了他。当他在提尔匝，他的家宰阿尔匝家喝醉酒时，

text_en: Zimri came in and struck him down and killed him, in the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, and succeeded him.
text_cn: 齐默黎冲入，击杀了他，篡夺了他的王位，时在犹大王阿撒二十七年。

text_en: When he began to reign, as soon as he had seated himself on his throne, he killed all the house of Baasha; he did not leave him a single male of his kindred or his friends.
text_cn: 齐默黎一登极，立刻屠杀了巴厄沙全家，没有给他留下一个男子，连他的亲属朋友都杀了。

text_en: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke against Baasha by the prophet Jehu—
text_cn: 齐默黎这样毁灭了巴厄沙全家，应验了上主藉先知耶胡斥责巴厄沙所说的话。

text_en: because of all the sins of Baasha and the sins of his son Elah that they committed, and that they caused Israel to commit, provoking the Lord God of Israel to anger with their idols.
text_cn: 这是因为巴厄沙和他的儿子厄拉所犯的一切罪，即引以色列陷于罪恶的罪，因他们制造了虚无偶像，激怒了上主，以色列的天主。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?
text_cn: 厄拉其余的事迹，他的一切作为，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: In the twenty-seventh year of King Asa of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the troops were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines,
text_cn: 犹大王阿撒二十七年，齐默黎在提尔匝作王仅七天。当时人民正在围攻培肋舍特人的基贝通，

text_en: and the troops who were encamped heard it said, “Zimri has conspired, and he has killed the king”; therefore all Israel made Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.
text_cn: 消息传到营中说：齐默黎已经叛变，击杀了君王，全以色列人当天即在营中，选立了军长敖默黎作以色列王。

text_en: So Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
text_cn: 敖默黎和与他在一起的全以色列人，从基贝通上去围攻提尔匝。

text_en: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the citadel of the king’s house; he burned down the king’s house over himself with fire, and died—
text_cn: 齐默黎一见城已失陷，即走进王宫的城堡，纵火焚烧王宫，自焚而死。

text_en: because of the sins that he committed, doing evil in the sight of the Lord , walking in the way of Jeroboam, and for the sin that he committed, causing Israel to sin.
text_cn: 这是因为他所犯的罪恶，行了上主视为恶的事，走了雅洛贝罕的路，并以自己所犯的罪，使以色列陷于罪恶。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the conspiracy that he made, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?
text_cn: 齐默黎其余的事迹，暗杀叛变的事，都记载在，《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts; half of the people followed Tibni son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.
text_cn: 那时，以色列人民分裂为二：一半跟随基纳特的儿子提贝尼，要立他为王；一半跟随敖默黎。

text_en: But the people who followed Omri overcame the people who followed Tibni son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri became king.
text_cn: 跟随敖默黎的人胜过了跟随基纳特的儿子提贝尼的人；提贝尼死后，敖默黎便作了王。

text_en: In the thirty-first year of King Asa of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel; he reigned for twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.
text_cn: 犹大王阿撒三十一年，敖默黎登极作以色列王，在位凡十二年，其中六年在提尔匝。

text_en: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver; he fortified the hill, and called the city that he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.
text_cn: 敖默黎用两"塔冷通"银子，由舍默尔手中买下了芍默龙山。他修建了这座山，依照山的原主舍默尔的名字，给他所建筑的城起名叫"撒玛黎雅。”

text_en: Omri did what was evil in the sight of the Lord ; he did more evil than all who were before him.
text_cn: 敖默黎行了上主视为恶的事，甚至比他以前的人更为邪恶。

text_en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam son of Nebat, and in the sins that he caused Israel to commit, provoking the Lord , the God of Israel, to anger by their idols.
text_cn: 事事仿效乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕所走的路，犯了使以色列陷于罪恶的罪，又敬拜邪神偶像，激怒上主，以色列的天主。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri that he did, and the power that he showed, are they not written in the Book of the Annals of the Kings of Israel?
text_cn: 敖默黎其余的事迹，他的作为和功迹，都记载在《以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: Omri slept with his ancestors, and was buried in Samaria; his son Ahab succeeded him.
text_cn: 敖默黎与列祖同眠，葬在撒玛黎雅；他的儿子阿哈布继位为王。

text_en: In the thirty-eighth year of King Asa of Judah, Ahab son of Omri began to reign over Israel; Ahab son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.
text_cn: 犹大王阿撒三十八年，敖默黎的儿子阿哈布登极作以色列王。敖默黎的儿子阿哈布在撒玛黎雅作以色列王，凡二十二年。

text_en: Ahab son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord more than all who were before him.
text_cn: 敖默黎的儿子阿哈布行了上主视为恶的事，甚于他以前的人。

text_en: And as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, he took as his wife Jezebel daughter of King Ethbaal of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshiped him.
text_cn: 他走了乃巴特的儿子雅洛贝罕犯罪的路，尚以为是小事，又娶了漆冬王厄特巴耳的女儿依则贝耳为妻，亲自去服事敬拜巴耳，

text_en: He erected an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he built in Samaria.
text_cn: 在撒玛黎雅为巴耳建筑了一座庙宇，庙内为巴耳设立了一座祭坛。

text_en: Ahab also made a sacred pole. Ahab did more to provoke the anger of the Lord , the God of Israel, than had all the kings of Israel who were before him.
text_cn: 阿哈布又立了阿舍辣；阿哈布行事激怒上主，以色列的天主，尤甚于他以前的以色列王。

text_en: In his days Hiel of Bethel built Jericho; he laid its foundation at the cost of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the Lord , which he spoke by Joshua son of Nun.
text_cn: 他在位的时候，贝特耳人希耳重建了耶里哥；奠基的时候，死了长子阿彼兰；安门的时候，死了幼子色古布：这正应验了上主藉农的儿子若苏厄所说的话。
